builds.name: One Meep bonus ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from One Meep bonus within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from One Meep bonus within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Helper Meep bonus is30+0.4AP plus6 per5 Chimes;100 Chimes gives candidate150+0.4AP magic. AP and MR modifiers strengthen this bonus. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. 100 earned Chimes; one ready Meep. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. 100 earned Chimes; one ready Meep. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record One Meep bonus tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

No finite global maximum with unlimited Chimes/time; verify helper progression; normal attack excluded. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Existing Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W numeric adapters cannot certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima.
